Detailed original procedural geometry; contours, bracket thickness, vent patterns, connectors and pivot positions are image-informed approximations.

profile.notes: Produces a forceful heated fog plume with integrated LEDs. Antari markets it as a CO2-style visual effect, but its documented consumable is FLC fog fluid; it is not a real CO2 jet.
profile.body_style: large faceted black fog machine with top emitter tray containing 27 multicolor LED modules, carry handles and base feet
